name: hvc_plastic_aud400_nih300
description: Experiment baseline (2026-11-20, round K; N_IH 300 with ~160 targets each since the N_IH test: same cancellation as 1200, a third of the interneurons): V2 network on the Schneider & Woolley front end, with plastic HVC -> I_HVC (eligibility traces credited by the I_HVC -> E Vogels change, divisive synaptic scaling to an 8 Hz I_HVC target). See docs/contrast-experiments.md, round K. Not the package defaults (those reproduce v0.7.0).
stimulus_note: 2026-11-22: linear divisive normalisation (sigma 0.05, power 1) replaces the squared one (sigma 0.3, power 2), which is non-monotone and splits the DAF response into two humps (docs/contrast-experiments.md, 'DAF shape'). trained_model is the linear-normalisation network (retrained 2026-11-22, monitor_hvc_plastic, 150 renditions); the cancellation results below are still from the squared-normalisation network (outputs/sweeps/rK_monitor/nih300.npz) and have not been re-measured.
